WITH per_player AS (
  SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS award_count
  FROM player AS p
  LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma
    ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.player_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_awards
  FROM per_player
)
SELECT per_player.player_id,
       per_player.award_count,
       per_player.award_count * 1.0 / total.total_awards AS ratio
FROM per_player
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
